intent: Product top chrome: brand mark on the start, centered kit Input search, trailing actions. Not a page title. Not a sidebar.
useWhen: Persistent product shell top bar with logo, global search, and utility actions
A full-bleed header above the page, not the page’s title block
doNotUseWhen: Page title, subtitle, Breadcrumb, or in-page actions — use PageHeader
Closeable product side nav — use SideNav
Horizontal site destinations and dropdowns — use NavigationMenu
Command palette overlay — use Command; AppHeader search is a kit Input

title.note: Product name next to the mark. Not an h1. Page titles belong on PageHeader.

mark.note: Brand letter. Defaults to the first character of title. Same idea as SideNav mark. Not a branded SVG.

logo.note: Custom mark or wordmark ReactNode. Replaces the default letter mark. Consumers pass their own logo. Do not copy a file-specific brand mark into the kit.

search.note: Renders a centered kit Input. Hide only when the shell has no global search.

searchValue.note: controlled. When set, pair with onSearch.

searchShortcut.note: Decorative Input end slot, e.g. ⌘K. Not a keybinding.

searchId.note: Passed to kit Input. Generated when omitted.

actions.note: kit Buttons. At most one primary. Do not put an assistant/Copilot CTA in the kit.

ariaLabel.note: header label. Defaults to title, then Application.

radius.note: Bar corners. none is a flush full-bleed bar. md is radius-surface-md for an inset floating bar.

requirements: header has aria-label from ariaLabel, title, or Application
Search is kit Input type=search with aria-label from searchPlaceholder
Mark sits in a layout-sidebar-compact slot, centered, so it shares the SideNav icon axis in layout-shell
Do not use h1 — page titles belong on PageHeader
At container 38rem, search stacks under brand and actions

doNot: Do not invent TopBar, SearchBar, Logo, Masthead, or AppBar cousins
Do not use PageHeader for product chrome
Do not leave a gap between AppHeader and SideNav — compose layout-shell over layout-app, both radius none
Do not pad the mark independently of layout-sidebar-compact — it must stay centered on SideNav icons
Do not use AppNav, SideNav, or NavigationMenu as a top bar with search
Do not bake a product logo SVG into the kit — use logo or mark
Do not add a Copilot, assistant, or sparkle CTA
Do not restyle kit Input internals
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions
snippet: <AppHeader title="Acme" mark="A" searchPlaceholder="Search" searchShortcut="⌘K" onSearch={setQuery} actions={<><Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconStart="Bell" ariaLabel="Notifications" /></>} />
